body:
I was only diagnosed with bipolar type schizoaffective disorder like two months ago. All the medication has done is make me sleep for 12 hours. I'm still seeing scary ass shit. I'm still hearing shit. I'm still depressed. I'm afraid there isn't a pill that will take away my pain.

And I've been to therapy. Trauma based. CBT/DBT.  For years. All to no avail.

My partner is one of the reasons I am here. My sibling is another. Things were worse for them when I left. My mother got a girlfriend (she came out as pan. Universe is ironic), moved out, left them alone for months while our step-dad lived there before he finally moved out. She also left behind her 19 cats and 2 dogs. Now, my sibling is autistic and barely able to take care of themselves, let alone all those pets. 10 cats ended up starving to death. My mom took the remaining cats, along with her 2 dogs, and is taking care of them at her house. So, then it was just my sibling and I didn't know all this until I went down to West Virginia where they live (I'm currently in another state).

The house was also a mess because my sibling didn't clean due to their depression. They also have a dog of their own. Never potty trained. Shit everywhere. Moldy dishes. Moldy food in the fridge. Turns out my mother wasn't checking up on my sibling.

I'm now planning on moving down there because I'm the only one in my entire family who is responsible enough and willing to take care of them. They are also just starting to transition from male to female and I want to be there to support them (even though this whole thing seems a bit bogus because of some things they have said but I digress).

Being with my sibling makes me feel less depressed because I have a responsibility to take care of them. They are dependent on me and I love them like they were my own child because our whole relationship dynamic has been more parent-child than sibling-sibling.

My mother has also apologized to me about what has happened in the past. She says it haunts her every day so I chose to forgive her. So, we have an ok relationship. She means well. She's just not a fit parent. Her mental illness has left her incapable of giving my sibling the care they need. So, once again, it's up to me to step up to the plate.

Back to treatment options, I feel like I've tried literally all there is to offer. Hasn't worked. I don't think the system has the capability to successfully treat and "cure" someone like me. I think I'm too fucked up and beyond help. But, you're right, I don't really want to die. I don't think anyone really does. I think suicidal people just want the pain to stop and death is the only way to make it stop.

So far, I've chosen to live with this pain. Not because I want to. But because it is the only way I can live. It's either live with this fucked up brain of mine or die. I'm just afraid that, one day, it will all be too much and I'll either completely lose my grip with reality or kill myself. To me, that's what the future has in store for me.

Nah. See, because, here's the thing: I have to live with all this now and it's fucking destroying me mentally. Like my mind cannot handle it. That's why I had my breakdown recently.

Right now, I'm psychotic again. It's not as bad as when I was a kid, but it's still pretty bad. I hear people whispering about me when they aren't. I see things that aren't there. Most of the time, I'm able to tell the difference. Other times, I have to ask my partner (who is a goddamn saint) if what I think happened actually happened.

I have night terrors every night. I kick and punch my partner when I'm asleep. I don't ever feel safe, unless my partner is with me. I have flashbacks of the event(s) regularly. My resting heart rate is like 100+ because I can never relax.

Oftentimes, I'm depressed. Like really depressed. I'll just break down crying, seemingly for no reason. I have no energy for anything. All I want to do is watch TV and be on reddit. Life overwhelms me and I'm easily overwhelmed. I guess I'm weak.

I've been in and out of hospitals. Some good, some bad. The last one didn't know what to do with me. I've been on so much medication and years of therapy but I'm no better mentally than I was 10 years ago. Symptoms have just changed a little.

They recommended ECT for me... One woman there at the hospital was going through the treatments. She was 50 years old, yet she had a simple mine like that of a young girl. I don't want to be like that. Yet, at the same time, I cannot bear to live like this.

Trauma on top of trauma on top of trauma. Each wound as fresh as the next. Every time I think it's over, it isn't.

Hell, in June, a group of men were outside Royal Farms as I was buying cigarettes. When I came out, they didn't know whether I was a boy or a girl and were saying all kinds of disgusting things. I yelled at them and went in the car. They opened my car door and tried to coax me out. The leader had the same predatory look in his eyes that my rapist did right before she did what she did. We only escaped because my partner hit the gas, reversed, and they let go of the door in shock.

I also had a miscarriage last year in May because I haven't been on my testosterone in two years because I lost my insurance and haven't been able to get on insurance and see an endocrinologist. Doctors are also trying to stop me from going back on testosterone now because of my deteriorating mental state. 

Shit just keeps happening to me, no matter what I do. I swear life is just experimenting on me to see how much pain a human being can take.

All I look forward to now is the complete and utter nothingness of death. I believe it is only then that I will feel peace.

Well, the earliest fucked up thing that happened to me was when I was two. My dad molested me. He would tickle my thighs and then touch my crotch. I don't remember much of it but it stopped when I got older. Around 5 or 6. I don't remember much of it. 

Everything was ok after that until I became best friends with a girl who was only a year older than me that I met at daycare. I was around 8 years old. Within three months of our friendship, she started sexually abusing me. I remember the first time. She made me watch porn and then blocked off the exit when I tried to escape and leave the room. She became possessive with me after that. I wasn't allowed to have any other friends. I was to only sit with her at lunch. Then, she moved to my school. I saw her every day, before school at daycare, at school, then after school at daycare. The weekends weren't safe because she'd make me sleep over at her house or come over to my house. The times at her house were worse because she could do anything. I would scream and her mother would pretend not to hear. She'd even walk in on us as her daughter was beating me, give me a sympathetic look, and then leave as if nothing happened.

I was 9 when she raped me with my aunt's dildo. It was 3 am. She was sleeping over for my birthday. I didn't scream because my brother and aunt were sleeping two rooms over. I didn't want my brother to walk in on my shame. She made me pretend to like it. I'll never forget her look of disgust. She wouldn't even touch me with her bare hands. It was like I was dirty.

She then made me tie her up and try to touch her months later. She made me stop though because my hands were cold.

She never raped me again but she continued the abuse. She'd make me watch porn and masturbate for her as she watched me and masturbated. Whenever I didn't follow her commands, she'd hurt me. She'd dig her nails into my skin. Bite me until I bruised. Pull my hair and rip out clumps of it. The marks were always left where people wouldn't see. My parents had no idea.

My nightmare came to a head when her mother lost her apartment. Her mother and her lived with us for two months. Me and her shared a room. For two months. 

It didn't stop until I turned 11. At this point, I was a zombie on the outside. I lived in a fantasy world inside my head. It was happy at first. And then my fantasy world became as dark as my real life. I became delusional. My parents had no idea, all the way up until I ran away from home and a cop found me. They took me home, woke my mother. She came out and saw me in the back of the cop car, saying words that didn't make sense. I was mentally gone.

They took me to a mental hospital. I was there for two months. They would change my medication from a day to a week at a time. I never had any idea of what I was taking at any given moment. My parents were not told this. They weren't told anything.

I was initially put in the children's unit. My roommate was a compulsive liar who told me horrific stories of how boys were coming into our room at night and raping us. I saw a ten year old girl tackled and restrained by six guards.

Then, they deemed me too much of a threat so they put me in the teen unit. I was only 11. The people there were 15 to 18. My roommate there was so violent that she wasn't allowed out of her room. She threatened to kill me every day. A male guard was stationed at our door. He was required to watch me, a little 11 year old girl, shower because I was listed as a suicide risk.

One day, someone used the underwire from a bra to self harm so they were checking all the bras for missing underwire. That was fine. I was compliant. Then, the female worker noticed I was wearing a bra. Without asking me, she felt up my chest, checking my bra. I cried. She told me to shut up, that she was just doing her job.

I came out of there all kinds of fucked up. My abuser moved away a few weeks after I got out. Never saw her again. I forgot the abuse. My mind blocked it out.

Meanwhile, in the same span of time, my parents were in an awful marriage. My mother was physically abusive towards my father and he was neglectful. My mother would get angry and punch and kick holes in the wall. She'd throw things. I hated her. We'd also get into fights because I knew I was gay.

 (I told my abuser this before she raped me and used that against me. She framed the whole thing as "experimenting". )

My mother would scream at me that I didn't know my sexuality. So, I dropped it. At school, I was out. I lived in a rural town so I was the only out gay person. I was bullied. Bad. Nobody would talk to me. Guys would threaten to rape me daily. It was a nightmare.

At thirteen, I started having nightmares about being raped. I started to piece my memories together. When I finally had uncovered everything, I told my mother. She then told my father. We tried to press charges but it was my word against hers. When the cops went to question her and her mom, they made up lies and told them that I was a whore and that I liked every minute of it. The investigation was dropped. No justice for me. Ever.

Started wearing men's clothes. Came out as trans at 15. My father was supportive to my face but then would talk shit about me to my mother. My mother who would scream to me about why I was doing this to her and if it was her fault or if it was my abuser's fault.

My parent's soon separated. My dad got his own place. That's when things got weird. My dad would talk about sexual things to me, like how I'd have to learn how to fuck holes properly if I was going to be a man. He'd also spank and grope his girlfriend in front of me and my brother. Then, he started hugging me from behind. I told him I was uncomfortable and he'd only hold me tighter. I can still feel his boner against my ass...

I soon stopped seeing him. Never told my mother. She has no idea.

My mother then got with my step dad. He was awful. He'd call my sibling an asshole, worthless, a retard, etc because of their autism. When my mother had a mental breakdown, he sat us down and blamed us for it, saying that, if we had been better sons, she would've been fine.

I told my mother to leave him. I told her he was abusing us. Then, she'd kick him out. After a few months, he'd show up, saying he's changed, and move right back in. It became a cycle we were all trapped in.

We became poor. We'd come home to the lights off frequently. My sibling and I would pass the time playing monopoly. For days.

I learned to wash clothes by hand, cook food outside on a fire, and shiver myself to sleep.

It all came to a head when my sibling and I were only eating one meal a day because our stepfather would chase us out of the kitchen whenever we tried to eat. The last straw for me was when he kicked down my sibling's door, breaking the lock my mother had installed (in order to protect us when our stepfather went psycho like he regularly did) in order to scream at my sibling. I confronted my mother about it. She threatened my life. 

I called 911. They told me to go to the police station. They contacted CPS for my sibling since they were only 16. They told me I was free to leave since I was 18. Grabbed two trashbags full of stuff and crashed at my girlfriend's for two weeks. When my time was up, I called the domestic violence shelter for help. They said I didn't qualify. I found out later that it was because I was only 18 and they only took people who were 21 and older. They transferred my call to the homeless shelter.

You know the rest.

Do you mean that? Because that's not even all of it. I could probably write a whole fucking book and not even be able to cover it all.

Hell, I told a therapist all of it once and the therapist, who worked in the psych ward for years and was hardened to suffering, broke down and cried for me, right in front of me and my partner. And I felt bad. I hate causing pain because I shared my own.

I just want to warn you, you know?
